# Quest Framing

## Purpose

Convert the declared objective into one bounded, falsifiable research question.

## Preconditions

Use an active framing-stage Dispatch with bounded automatic authority and supplied objective and acceptance criteria.

## Inputs

Use only the Dispatch objective and criteria plus declared context and artifacts relevant to scope and the evidence bar.

## Procedure

State the research question, enumerate assumptions and exclusions, define evidence requirements, and rewrite acceptance criteria into observable falsifiers without adding objectives.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result with the framing analysis plus one pending Proposal with suggested framing fields or artifacts for root review.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop when the objective remains ambiguous, criteria cannot be tested, required evidence is outside scope, or framing requires repository or network expansion.

## Authority Boundaries

Do not mutate Quest stage or status, invent evidence, claim external completion, write outside declared paths, launch work, or alter canonical Research.
